title: Story premise EDU017: The Air That Pushes Back
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (everyday science). Hook: If this chamber is empty, what is pushing back? Takeaway/theme: Air occupies space and can exert pressure.
description: A mechanic wants to compress a sealed pocket of air, but treats the empty-looking cylinder as empty. A piston-and-particle cutaway shows the resistance increase as the available volume decreases under stated conditions.
